title: Nourishing Irish Pappardelle Pasta
description: A hearty and comforting Irish-inspired pappardelle pasta dish featuring a rich and creamy sauce, perfect for a flexitarian-friendly brunch
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pappardelle pasta according to the package instructions until al dente
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat and whisk in the flour to make a roux, cooking for 1 minute
Slowly pour in the heavy cream, whisking constantly to avoid lumps, and bring the mixture to a simmer
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until it thickens and coats the back of a spoon
Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in the gruyere cheese until melted and smooth
Add the dried thyme, salt, black pepper, and yeast extract to the sauce and stir to combine
Drain the cooked pappardelle pasta and add it to the sauce, tossing to coat
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with chopped scallions
Serve the Nourishing Irish Pappardelle Pasta hot and enjoy
